purpose: Baseline record before adding the RENEP (Portugal/Azores) caster. This configuration produces real OPERATIONAL skill but cannot test spatial structure: all stations lie in a narrow annulus, so kriging weights span only 3.9% and permuting the geometry is a no-op.

specificity_controls.note: Controls share the data, kernel, alpha and gating with the TEP arm; only the geometry (permuted) or the common mode (removed) differ.

interpretation: Operational skill is real and substantial. The specificity controls read ~0, so on THIS network the skill is network common mode with no detectable spatial structure — as expected from a 3.9% kriging-weight spread.
